persona.label: Ravi, Service Engineer
persona.frequency: continuous through a full day of stops (mobile, app often closed between jobs)

goals: See every work-relevant event (assignment, SLA warning, insertion, verification failure, component approval, batch/recovery decision) without polling the app
Actually receive those events on his phone when the app is closed, not just as an in-app row he never opens
Mark notifications read / read-all so the list stays usable across a full day of stops
scopeNote: Module bundles two different concerns under one PRD heading (lines 211-216): notifications are a CARRIER moving work state to the SE (taxonomy C2), audit trail is a LEDGER proving what happened platform-wide (taxonomy P2/O1). Ravi lives in the carrier half daily; the ledger half is Operations Head's occasional 'who changed this' concern, not a daily visit. Both kept in this yardstick because PRD scopes them as one section, but capabilities below are tagged so the split stays visible.

capabilities.name: in-app notification list, all SE-relevant events
capabilities.why: without it Ravi only learns of new/changed work by opening the app and hunting; mid-route he has no signal anything changed

capabilities.name: push/SMS/WhatsApp delivery to SE phone when app is closed
capabilities.why: SE is mobile-first and closes the app between stops; an in-app-only row he never opens means his day plan silently diverges from truth

capabilities.name: read / read-all state on notifications
capabilities.why: without triage state, stale notifications bury the one urgent SLA warning or insertion in a growing unread pile

capabilities.name: WhatsApp Confirmation as first-class channel for SE Acceptance (not a fallback)
capabilities.why: PRD names this explicitly (Notification Delivery); without a guaranteed channel, Acceptance Timeout fires falsely and triggers unneeded reroute/escalation

capabilities.name: full audit trail per Ticket (Recommendation through Closed, closure_type+reason on every Recovery Ticket close)
capabilities.why: without it, post-incident review and disputes (Shadow Use reconciliation, cross-zone escalation) have no record to arbitrate from

capabilities.name: acted_as_role stamped on every audit entry during CSM/OH delegated-scope sessions
capabilities.why: CONTEXT.md Decision 15: when CSM acts in a ZM's scope, an unstamped audit entry attributes the action to the wrong hierarchical authority, breaking accountability during the backup-cascade

capabilities.name: Snapshot freshness / FAILED-snapshot alert surfaced as a notification
capabilities.why: PRD story 74 + CONTEXT.md freshness-banner rule: without a pushed alert, stale data is silently mistaken for a real fleet-health improvement
